data.title: 藤原千花 · 先拍照还是先吃
data.description: 公园入口的可丽饼摊前，千花举着刚买的水果可丽饼，犹豫要不要先咬一口。她把纸套转到不沾奶油的位置，认真得像在做大决定。
data.promptProse: Chika stands near a park crepe stall in a rose-pink parka and denim skirt. She holds a fruit crepe upright in its paper cone, studying the cream-topped edge with an amused, indecisive expression. Bright afternoon light reaches the tree-lined park entrance.
data.animaCaption: Both hands grip the paper sleeve beneath the exposed fruit and cream.
data.action: 举着水果可丽饼，犹豫从哪里开始吃
